name: Rau Neytu
source:
An anthropomorphic alligator found in an ancient tomb for reasons unknown. Likely owing to her many years in enchanted sleep, she remembers very little other than her dearest friend, Neymi. In addition to her native Aksendi, she seems to command fluency of the Mosaic's language.

(in-game profile)
